Attached: 1 image

When your AI keeps going in circles on a long task, start a fresh chat.

Microsoft researchers tested this with AI agents on long tasks. Clearing the chat history let the agent find better answers. Clearing context alone lifted scores 22%.

The files and finished work stayed. Only the conversation reset. Open a new chat, paste in a short summary of what's done, and keep going.

#AI #Productivity
